name: Conduikt Build-in-Public Content Engine (29 nodes)
description: Automated build-in-public content engine for Conduikt. Fetches project context from GitHub, generates X and LinkedIn posts via Claude API, posts via platform APIs. 29 nodes across 3 trigger paths (schedule, webhook, manual). Persistent state stored in Supabase n8n_content_state table.

nodes.name: GitHub Push Webhook
nodes.notes: Receives push events from conduikt repo master branch. Configure GitHub webhook to POST to this URL with ref filter refs/heads/master.

nodes.name: Manual Trigger
nodes.notes: For testing the workflow manually

nodes.name: Configuration
nodes.notes: Central configuration node. Set dry_run to false when ready to go live. Env vars: CLAUDE_API_KEY, TWITTER_*, LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN, LINKEDIN_PERSON_ID, GITHUB_TOKEN, SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.

nodes.name: Fetch WORKPLAN.md
nodes.notes: Fetches WORKPLAN.md from the Conduikt GitHub repo. Continue on fail with empty string fallback.

nodes.name: Fetch CHANGELOG.md
nodes.notes: Fetches CHANGELOG.md from the Conduikt GitHub repo. Continue on fail with empty string fallback.

nodes.name: Fetch Recent Commits
nodes.notes: Fetches the last 10 commits from the Conduikt GitHub repo. Continue on fail with empty array fallback.

nodes.name: Fetch Screenshots Index
nodes.notes: Fetches screenshots/index.json for image selection. Continue on fail with empty object fallback.

nodes.name: Load Memory
nodes.notes: Loads posted history and category rotation state from Supabase n8n_content_state table. Falls back to empty state if Supabase is unreachable.

nodes.name: Prepare Inputs
nodes.notes: Decodes base64 GitHub content, formats commits, merges all context. Handles fetch failures with fallback values (empty string, empty array, empty object).

nodes.name: Construct Prompt
nodes.notes: Splits prompt into system instruction (role, tone, rules, format) and user content (commits, workplan, changelog). These map to Claude's system parameter and messages array.

nodes.name: Claude API
nodes.notes: Calls Claude claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 with system instruction in top-level system parameter and user content in messages array

nodes.name: Parse Response
nodes.notes: Extracts JSON from Claude's response, handles code fences and parse errors gracefully

nodes.name: Check Duplicate
nodes.notes: Checks for near-duplicate posts (>60% word overlap) and banned topics

nodes.name: Has Post?
nodes.notes: Routes to posting flow if skip_reason is null/empty, otherwise logs and ends

nodes.name: Log Skip
nodes.notes: Logs the reason this run was skipped (duplicate, banned topic, parse error, etc.)

nodes.name: Select Image
nodes.notes: Matches image_category from Claude's response to screenshots/index.json and picks a random image

nodes.name: Is Dry Run?
nodes.notes: If dry_run is true, log the post content without actually posting. If false, proceed to live posting.

nodes.name: Log Dry Run
nodes.notes: Logs the full post content for review during testing

nodes.name: Has Image?
nodes.notes: Routes to media upload flow if an image was selected, otherwise posts text only

nodes.name: Download Image
nodes.notes: Downloads the selected screenshot from GitHub raw content

nodes.name: Upload Media to Twitter
nodes.notes: Uploads image to Twitter media endpoint. Requires OAuth 1.0a signing (handled via credentials).

nodes.name: Sign OAuth (Media)
nodes.notes: Constructs OAuth 1.0a signature for the Twitter v2 tweet endpoint (with media)

nodes.name: Post Media Tweet
nodes.notes: Posts tweet with media attachment via Twitter API v2

nodes.name: Sign OAuth (Text Only)
nodes.notes: Constructs OAuth 1.0a signature for text-only tweet

nodes.name: Post Text Tweet
nodes.notes: Posts text-only tweet via Twitter API v2

nodes.name: LinkedIn Adapter
nodes.notes: Prepares LinkedIn post data with person ID for the Community Management API

nodes.name: Post to LinkedIn
nodes.notes: Posts via LinkedIn Community Management API (rest/posts endpoint, version 202402). Replaces deprecated v2/ugcPosts.

nodes.name: Save State
nodes.notes: Persists posted content history and rotation index to Supabase n8n_content_state table via PATCH. Falls back to console log if Supabase is unreachable.
